# `lsp`

> Profile: deferred · Permission key: `[permission] lsp`

Language Server Protocol tool — diagnostics, hover, definition, references, type_definition, implementation, document/workspace symbols. Requires a language server installed for the file type.

Deferred tools are not advertised on every request. Activate one with `tool_search` or set `session.tool_profile = "full"`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | one of `diagnostics`, `hover`, `definition`, `references`, `type_definition`, `implementation`, `symbols` | yes | What LSP action to perform |
| `character` | integer | no | 1-indexed character offset on the line |
| `file_path` | string | no | Absolute path to the file to analyze |
| `line` | integer | no | 1-indexed line number (required for hover, definition, references, type_definition, implementation) |
| `query` | string | no | Workspace symbol query (symbols action without file_path) |
